articles.text: 学生: 地下鉄の駅から歌舞伎座まで歩いて5分ぐらいです。 (Gakusei: Chikatetsu no eki kara Kabukiza made aruite 5-fun gurai desu.)
STUDENT: From the subway station to Kabukiza, it's about a 5-minute walk.
学生: アメリカ大使館から山王ホテルまで歩いて20分ぐらいです。 (Gakusei: Amerika Taishikan kara Sannoo Hoteru made aruite 20-pun gurai desu.)
STUDENT: From the American Embassy to the Sanno Hotel, it's about a 20-minute walk.
学生: 新宿駅から新宿御苑まで歩いて15分ぐらいです。 (Gakusei: Shinjuku-eki kara Shinjuku Gyoen made aruite 15-fun gurai desu.)
STUDENT: From Shinjuku Station to Shinjuku Gyoen, it's about a 15-minute walk.
学生: 上野駅から上野公園まで歩いて10分ぐらいです。 (Gakusei: Ueno-eki kara Ueno Kooen made aruite 10-pun gurai desu.)
STUDENT: From Ueno Station to Ueno Park, it's about a 10-minute walk.
学生: 日比谷公園から国会議事堂まで歩いて25分ぐらいです。 (Gakusei: Hibiya Kooen kara Kokkai Gijidoo made aruite 25-fun gurai desu.)
STUDENT: From Hibiya Park to the Diet Building, it's about a 25-minute walk.
